articles.title: Payment giants Stripe, Visa, Mastercard said to be among backers of soon-to-debut stablecoin platform
articles.snippet: U.S. crypto exchange Coinbase is also said to be looking into the possibility of participating in the new stablecoin platform.

articles.title: Banks' survey says people don't want to rock the boat if stablecoin yield risks lending
articles.snippet: The American Bankers Association, which lobbies against the crypto sector over the Clarity Act's stablecoin section, unveiled its new polling.

articles.title: Zcash fixes Orchard bug after emergency network upgrade
articles.snippet: Zcash Open Development Lab said the network briefly became unstable as miners upgraded, while the Zcash Foundation said there was no evidence of an exploit.

articles.title: Russian ruble stablecoin A7A5 grows despite Western sanctions: CertiK
articles.snippet: Russian ruble-backed stablecoin A7A5 processed over $110 billion in transactions despite Western sanctions, according to CertiK.

articles.title: Mastercard expands support to USDC, PYUSD, RLUSD stablecoin settlement
articles.snippet: The payments giant said USDC, PYUSD, RLUSD and other stablecoins will support new settlement options across multiple blockchains.
